name: Bulbasaur
entry: The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.

name: Ivysaur
entry: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

name: Venusaur
entry: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.

name: Charmander
entry: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

name: Charmeleon
entry: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.

name: Charizard
entry: If CHARIZARD becomes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a light blue shade.

name: Squirtle
entry: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.

name: Wartortle
entry: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.

name: Blastoise
entry: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

name: Starly
entry: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Staravia
entry: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

name: Staraptor
entry: When STARAVIA evolve into STARAPTOR, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Bidoof
entry: It lives in groups by the water. It chews up boulders and trees around its nest with its incisors.

name: Bibarel
entry: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

name: Wurmple
entry: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Silcoon
entry: Having wrapped silk around the branches of a tree, it quiescently awaits evolution.

name: Beautifly
entry: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

name: Cascoon
entry: It endures attacks with patience, because the more pain before evolution, the sturdier it becomes.

name: Dustox
entry: It scatters its fine dust all over when it is attacked. It is a nocturnal Pokémon.

name: Hoothoot
entry: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Noctowl
entry: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

name: Poochyena
entry: It chases its prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it turns tail if the prey strikes back.

name: Mightyena
entry: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Blitzle
entry: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
entry: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Caterpie
entry: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Metapod
entry: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it prepares to evolve. It stays motionless in the shell.

name: Butterfree
entry: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Weedle
entry: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Kakuna
entry: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

name: Beedrill
entry: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

name: Ledyba
entry: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.

name: Ledian
entry: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

name: Zigzagoon
entry: It gets interested in everything, which is why it zigs and zags. It is good at finding items.

name: Linoone
entry: When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.

name: Litleo
entry: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pyroar
entry: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

name: Shinx
entry: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.

name: Luxio
entry: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

name: Luxray
entry: LUXRAY’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

name: Spinarak
entry: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

name: Ariados
entry: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.

name: Venipede
entry: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

name: Whirlipede
entry: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.

name: Scolipede
entry: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

name: Purrloin
entry: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
entry: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

name: Sentret
entry: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

name: Furret
entry: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

name: Pidgey
entry: It usually hides in tall grass. Because it dislikes fighting, it protects itself by kicking up sand.

name: Pidgeotto
entry: It has outstanding vision. However high it flies, it is able to distinguish the movements of its prey.

name: Pidgeot
entry: Its well-developed chest muscles make it strong enough to whip up a gusty windstorm with just a few flaps.

name: Nidoran♀
entry: The poison hidden in its small horn is extremely potent. Even a tiny scratch can have fatal results.

name: Nidorina
entry: When feeding its young, it first chews the food into a paste, then spits it out for the offspring.

name: Nidoqueen
entry: Its body is covered with needle-like scales. It never shows signs of shrinking from any attack.

name: Nidoran♂
entry: It is small, but its horn is filled with poison. It charges then stabs with the horn to inject poison.

name: Nidorino
entry: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

name: Nidoking
entry: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.

name: Skiddo
entry: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
entry: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Azurill
entry: Its tail is packed full of the nutrients it needs to grow.

name: Marill
entry: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.

name: Azumarill
entry: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

name: Pichu
entry: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

name: Pikachu
entry: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

name: Raichu
entry: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Rattata
entry: It eats anything. Wherever food is available, it will settle down and produce offspring continuously.

name: Raticate
entry: Gnaws on anything with its tough fangs. It can even topple concrete buildings by gnawing on them.

name: Fletchling
entry: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

name: Fletchinder
entry: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

name: Talonflame
entry: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

name: Spearow
entry: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.

name: Fearow
entry: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

name: Ekans
entry: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.

name: Arbok
entry: Transfixing prey with the face-like pattern on its belly, it binds and poisons the frightened victim.

name: Nincada
entry: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

name: Ninjask
entry: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

name: Shedinja
entry: A strange Pokémon--it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

name: Smeargle
entry: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

name: Aipom
entry: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

name: Ambipom
entry: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

name: Meowth
entry: It is fascinated by round objects. It can’t stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.

name: Persian
entry: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.

name: Pachirisu
entry: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

name: Burmy
entry: It covers itself with a cloak to shelter from the cold. When it’s hot, its cloak is thinner.

name: Wormadam
entry: It is said that a WORMADAM that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.

name: Mothim
entry: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the COMBEE hive.

name: Combee
entry: At night, COMBEE sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.

name: Vespiquen
entry: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control COMBEE.

name: Buneary
entry: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it’s scared, both ears are rolled up.

name: Lopunny
entry: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.

name: Ponyta
entry: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.

name: Rapidash
entry: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.

name: Mankey
entry: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.

name: Primeape
entry: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

name: Snubbull
entry: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.

name: Granbull
entry: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

name: Slakoth
entry: The way SLAKOTH lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Vigoroth
entry: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

name: Slaking
entry: The world’s laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there’s no food left within its reach.

name: Stantler
entry: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

name: Scatterbug
entry: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
entry: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Vivillon
entry: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Taillow
entry: When it gets cold, they migrate, flying over 180 miles a day. It hunts for tasty prey.

name: Swellow
entry: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

name: Emolga
entry: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Budew
entry: When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.

name: Roselia
entry: ROSELIA that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

name: Roserade
entry: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

name: Deerling
entry: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

name: Cleffa
entry: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Clefairy
entry: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

name: Clefable
entry: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

name: Igglybuff
entry: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

name: Jigglypuff
entry: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

name: Wigglytuff
entry: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.

name: Croagunk
entry: Fluid squeezed from its finger, albeit poisonous, is a significant ingredient in remedies for lower-back pain.

name: Toxicroak
entry: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

name: Tauros
entry: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd’s protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

name: Miltank
entry: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

name: Happiny
entry: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.

name: Chansey
entry: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

name: Blissey
entry: Anyone who takes even one taste of BLISSEY’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

name: Mime Jr.
entry: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

name: Mr. Mime
entry: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisible objects as it matures.

name: Wynaut
entry: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.

name: Wobbuffet
entry: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

name: Togepi
entry: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
entry: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss
entry: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

name: Farfetch'd
entry: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant stalks grow, it uses its own stalk to thwart them.

name: Hawlucha
entry: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

name: Audino
entry: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

name: Chikorita
entry: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sunrays.

name: Bayleef
entry: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

name: Meganium
entry: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

name: Cyndaquil
entry: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

name: Quilava
entry: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

name: Typhlosion
entry: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

name: Totodile
entry: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

name: Croconaw
entry: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr
entry: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

name: Kricketot
entry: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Kricketune
entry: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

name: Vulpix
entry: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.

name: Ninetales
entry: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

name: Pancham
entry: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Pangoro
entry: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Hoppip
entry: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

name: Skiploom
entry: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

name: Jumpluff
entry: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores-- it can even float around the world.

name: Growlithe
entry: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
entry: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.

name: Psyduck
entry: It has mystical powers but doesn’t recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

name: Golduck
entry: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Lillipup
entry: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

name: Herdier
entry: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

name: Stoutland
entry: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

name: Teddiursa
entry: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they’re soaked with honey.

name: Ursaring
entry: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen berries.

name: Spritzee
entry: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

name: Aromatisse
entry: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

name: Swirlix
entry: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

name: Slurpuff
entry: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

name: Electrike
entry: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

name: Manectric
entry: Its nest can be found where a thunderbolt hits. It is discharging electricity from its mane.

name: Cherubi
entry: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

name: Cherrim
entry: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

name: Skorupi
entry: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

name: Drapion
entry: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

name: Petilil
entry: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Lilligant
entry: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Lotad
entry: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

name: Lombre
entry: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

name: Ludicolo
entry: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Seedot
entry: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

name: Nuzleaf
entry: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
entry: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

name: Oddish
entry: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.

name: Gloom
entry: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Vileplume
entry: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Bellossom
entry: BELLOSSOM gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: Foongus
entry: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

name: Amoonguss
entry: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

name: Machop
entry: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

name: Machoke
entry: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.

name: Machamp
entry: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Espurr
entry: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

name: Meowstic
entry: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

name: Tropius
entry: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored tropical snack.

name: Sewaddle
entry: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Swadloon
entry: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Leavanny
entry: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Volbeat
entry: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by ILLUMISE.

name: Illumise
entry: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

name: Dwebble
entry: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Crustle
entry: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.

name: Patrat
entry: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Watchog
entry: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Carnivine
entry: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

name: Yanma
entry: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Yanmega
entry: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Sunkern
entry: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.

name: Sunflora
entry: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

name: Cottonee
entry: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.

name: Whimsicott
entry: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

name: Spoink
entry: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.

name: Grumpig
entry: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Plusle
entry: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Minun
entry: Exposure to electricity from MINUN and PLUSLE promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Bellsprout
entry: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
entry: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

name: Victreebel
entry: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.

name: Zangoose
entry: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a SEVIPER nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

name: Seviper
entry: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any ZANGOOSE. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

name: Mareep
entry: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

name: Flaaffy
entry: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

name: Ampharos
entry: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Scraggy
entry: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

name: Scrafty
entry: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

name: Skitty
entry: It’s adorable when it chases its own tail. It’s difficult to earn its trust.

name: Delcatty
entry: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Venonat
entry: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.

name: Venomoth
entry: When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poisonous powder all around.

name: Natu
entry: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

name: Xatu
entry: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Karrablast
entry: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

name: Escavalier
entry: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.

name: Shelmet
entry: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

name: Accelgor
entry: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Heracross
entry: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.

name: Druddigon
entry: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Deino
entry: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

name: Zweilous
entry: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

name: Hydreigon
entry: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

name: Dratini
entry: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

name: Dragonair
entry: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Dragonite
entry: It is said that this Pokémon constantly flies over the immense seas and rescues drowning people.

name: Treecko
entry: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Grovyle
entry: It leaps from tree branch to tree branch quite swiftly. It shows astounding agility.

name: Sceptile
entry: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

name: Torchic
entry: Inside its body is a place where it keeps a small flame. Hug it! It will be as warm as a hot-water bottle.

name: Combusken
entry: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Blaziken
entry: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.

name: Mudkip
entry: Its power can crush boulders. It rests by covering itself with mud at the bottom of a river.

name: Marshtomp
entry: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

name: Swampert
entry: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.

name: Poliwag
entry: Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.

name: Poliwhirl
entry: The swirl on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it may gradually cause drowsiness.

name: Poliwrath
entry: This strong and skilled swimmer is even capable of crossing the Pacific Ocean just by kicking.

name: Politoed
entry: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

name: Horsea
entry: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its well-developed dorsal fin.

name: Seadra
entry: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in HORSEA. It became a hot topic.

name: Kingdra
entry: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

name: Magikarp
entry: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but usually not more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados
entry: They say that during past strife, GYARADOS would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.

name: Feebas
entry: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms in schools and lives at the bottom of rivers.

name: Milotic
entry: It’s said that a glimpse of a MILOTIC and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

name: Gastly
entry: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

name: Haunter
entry: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, HAUNTER lurks, silently stalking its next victim.

name: Gengar
entry: It steals heat from its surroundings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.

name: Paras
entry: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.

name: Parasect
entry: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushroom on its back.

name: Tentacool
entry: When the tide goes out, dehydrated TENTACOOL remains can be found washed up on the shore.

name: Tentacruel
entry: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to constrict its prey and enemies.

name: Inkay
entry: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

name: Malamar
entry: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Slowpoke
entry: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.

name: Slowbro
entry: If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary SLOWPOKE.

name: Slowking
entry: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

name: Murkrow
entry: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow
entry: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its MURKROW followers.

name: Misdreavus
entry: It likes playing mischievous tricks, such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

name: Mismagius
entry: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Phantump
entry: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Trevenant
entry: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Gourgeist
entry: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Tangela
entry: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively unnerve its foes.

name: Tangrowth
entry: When it remains still, it appears to be a large shrub. Unsuspecting prey that wander near get ensnared by its vines.

name: Kecleon
entry: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

name: Drowzee
entry: If you think that you had a good dream but you can’t remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.

name: Hypno
entry: When it is very hungry, it puts humans it meets to sleep, then it feasts on their dreams.

name: Shellder
entry: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

name: Cloyster
entry: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

name: Krabby
entry: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kingler
entry: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincer’s size makes it difficult to aim properly.

name: Binacle
entry: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

name: Barbaracle
entry: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

name: Goldeen
entry: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

name: Seaking
entry: During spawning season, SEAKING gather from all over, causing rivers to appear a brilliant red.

name: Staryu
entry: At night, the middle of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

name: Starmie
entry: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

name: Girafarig
entry: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

name: Sableye
entry: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Houndour
entry: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: Houndoom
entry: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

name: Phanpy
entry: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

name: Donphan
entry: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

name: Surskit
entry: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

name: Masquerain
entry: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction-- to and fro and sideways.

name: Shroomish
entry: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.

name: Breloom
entry: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Spiritomb
entry: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

name: Shuppet
entry: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.

name: Banette
entry: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Sigilyph
entry: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

name: Exeggcute
entry: Their shells are very durable. Even if they crack, they can survive without spilling their contents.

name: Exeggutor
entry: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.

name: Cubone
entry: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.

name: Marowak
entry: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

name: Qwilfish
entry: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

name: Buizel
entry: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

name: Floatzel
entry: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Shellos
entry: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.

name: Gastrodon
entry: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.

name: Gothita
entry: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.

name: Gothorita
entry: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

name: Gothitelle
entry: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.

name: Hippopotas
entry: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.

name: Hippowdon
entry: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

name: Lunatone
entry: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Solrock
entry: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Scyther
entry: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Scizor
entry: It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

name: Seel
entry: Although it can’t walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It especially loves being in frigid seas.

name: Dewgong
entry: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.

name: Slugma
entry: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
entry: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

name: Corsola
entry: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

name: Remoraid
entry: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
entry: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Mantyke
entry: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.

name: Mantine
entry: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

name: Drifloon
entry: It is whispered that any child who mistakes DRIFLOON for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

name: Drifblim
entry: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

name: Litwick
entry: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

name: Lampent
entry: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

name: Chandelure
entry: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

name: Frillish
entry: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

name: Jellicent
entry: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Wooper
entry: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Quagsire
entry: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

name: Swinub
entry: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Piloswine
entry: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

name: Mamoswine
entry: A frozen MAMOSWINE was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

name: Wingull
entry: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

name: Pelipper
entry: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.

name: Chinchou
entry: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

name: Lanturn
entry: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

name: Corphish
entry: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

name: Crawdaunt
entry: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

name: Riolu
entry: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Lucario
entry: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to LUCARIO, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Carvanha
entry: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.

name: Sharpedo
entry: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

name: Wailmer
entry: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

name: Wailord
entry: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.

name: Finneon
entry: Swimming and fluttering its two tail fins, it looks like a BEAUTIFLY. At night, the patterns on its tail fins softly shine.

name: Lumineon
entry: LUMINEON swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.

name: Clamperl
entry: When it evolves, it makes a mysterious pearl that amplifies psychic powers when it’s held.

name: Huntail
entry: It lives deep in the pitch-dark sea. It attracts prey by moving its tail in mimicry of a small animal.

name: Gorebyss
entry: Its pink body becomes more vivid with the rise of water temperatures in the springtime.

name: Relicanth
entry: Discovered by chance during deep-sea explorations, it has not changed since ancient times.

name: Bergmite
entry: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Avalugg
entry: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Sneasel
entry: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Weavile
entry: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

name: Vanillite
entry: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

name: Vanillish
entry: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

name: Vanilluxe
entry: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Snorunt
entry: It’s said that if they are seen at midnight, they’ll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

name: Glalie
entry: It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere. It uses this power to freeze its foes.

name: Froslass
entry: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS.

name: Cryogonal
entry: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.

name: Cubchoo
entry: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.

name: Beartic
entry: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

name: Spheal
entry: It crosses the oceans by rolling itself on drifting ice. Fluffy fur keeps it warm when the temperature is below freezing.

name: Sealeo
entry: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

name: Walrein
entry: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

name: Barboach
entry: BARBOACH uses its whiskers to taste things just as a person uses his or her tongue to taste things.

name: Whiscash
entry: It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.

name: Pinsir
entry: With its pincer horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.

name: Joltik
entry: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.

name: Galvantula
entry: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

name: Goomy
entry: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

name: Sliggoo
entry: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Goodra
entry: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Turtwig
entry: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

name: Grotle
entry: A GROTLE that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

name: Torterra
entry: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic TORTERRA dwelled.

name: Chimchar
entry: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Monferno
entry: A bigger fire on its tail and a brighter blue pattern on its face means its rank in its pack is higher.

name: Infernape
entry: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

name: Piplup
entry: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

name: Prinplup
entry: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

name: Empoleon
entry: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

name: Zubat
entry: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.

name: Golbat
entry: However hard its victim’s hide may be, it punctures with sharp fangs and gorges itself with blood.

name: Crobat
entry: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

name: Geodude
entry: Most people may not notice, but a closer look should reveal that there are many GEODUDE around.

name: Graveler
entry: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

name: Golem
entry: It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hardens and crumbles away.

name: Sandshrew
entry: If it fell from a great height, this Pokémon could save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.

name: Sandslash
entry: In an attempt to hide itself, it will run around at top speed to kick up a blinding dust storm.

name: Diglett
entry: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Dugtrio
entry: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

name: Meditite
entry: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.

name: Medicham
entry: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.

name: Nosepass
entry: If two of these meet, they cannot get too close because their noses repel each other.

name: Probopass
entry: It controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack the foe from three directions.

name: Ralts
entry: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

name: Kirlia
entry: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Gardevoir
entry: It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely with.

name: Gallade
entry: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

name: Pidove
entry: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

name: Tranquill
entry: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

name: Unfezant
entry: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

name: Munna
entry: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

name: Musharna
entry: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

name: Sandile
entry: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

name: Krokorok
entry: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

name: Krookodile
entry: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

name: Makuhita
entry: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Hariyama
entry: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

name: Abra
entry: It senses impending attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.

name: Kadabra
entry: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.

name: Alakazam
entry: Closing both its eyes heightens all its other senses. This enables it to use its abilities to their extremes.

name: Baltoy
entry: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some BALTOY have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
entry: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.

name: Numel
entry: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

name: Camerupt
entry: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

name: Cacnea
entry: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

name: Cacturne
entry: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

name: Maractus
entry: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

name: Solosis
entry: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

name: Duosion
entry: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

name: Reuniclus
entry: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

name: Bronzor
entry: Ancient people believed that the pattern on BRONZOR’s back contained a mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
entry: Ancient people believed that petitioning BRONZONG for rain was the way to make crops grow.

name: Skarmory
entry: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

name: Torkoal
entry: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

name: Stunfisk
entry: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

name: Onix
entry: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

name: Steelix
entry: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

name: Roggenrola
entry: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
entry: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Gigalith
entry: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

name: Dunsparce
entry: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

name: Pineco
entry: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t bother it.

name: Forretress
entry: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: Drilbur
entry: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

name: Excadrill
entry: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

name: Carbink
entry: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

name: Glameow
entry: When it’s happy, GLAMEOW demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

name: Purugly
entry: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

name: Timburr
entry: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

name: Gurdurr
entry: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

name: Conkeldurr
entry: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

name: Mawile
entry: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Kangaskhan
entry: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

name: Grimer
entry: As it moves, it loses bits of its body, from which new GRIMER emerge. This worsens the stench around it.

name: Muk
entry: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.

name: Shuckle
entry: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

name: Rhyhorn
entry: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

name: Rhydon
entry: Its rugged hide protects it from even the heat of lava. However, the hide also makes it insensitive.

name: Rhyperior
entry: From holes in its palms, it fires out GEODUDE. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Noibat
entry: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

name: Noivern
entry: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

name: Honedge
entry: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

name: Doublade
entry: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
entry: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Aron
entry: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

name: Lairon
entry: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Aggron
entry: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.

name: Larvitar
entry: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it falls asleep so it can grow.

name: Pupitar
entry: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: Tyranitar
entry: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: Snivy
entry: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Servine
entry: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

name: Serperior
entry: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Tepig
entry: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

name: Pignite
entry: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
entry: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Oshawott
entry: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

name: Dewott
entry: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Samurott
entry: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Trapinch
entry: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

name: Vibrava
entry: It vibrates its wings vigorously, creating ultrasonic waves that cause serious headaches.

name: Flygon
entry: It is nicknamed “The Desert Spirit” because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

name: Doduo
entry: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.

name: Dodrio
entry: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

name: Chatot
entry: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.

name: Ducklett
entry: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
entry: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Swablu
entry: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.

name: Altaria
entry: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.

name: Duskull
entry: If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their parents, it will spirit them away--or so it’s said.

name: Dusclops
entry: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

name: Dusknoir
entry: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits along with it.

name: Chingling
entry: It emits high-frequency cries that people can’t hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully long time.

name: Chimecho
entry: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

name: Golett
entry: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

name: Golurk
entry: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

name: Pansage
entry: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Simisage
entry: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Pansear
entry: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Simisear
entry: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Panpour
entry: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
entry: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Gligar
entry: It flies straight at its target’s face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Gliscor
entry: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

name: Smoochum
entry: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

name: Jynx
entry: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

name: Elekid
entry: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it only charges up a little bit.

name: Electabuzz
entry: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.

name: Electivire
entry: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

name: Magby
entry: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble from its mouth and nostrils.

name: Magmar
entry: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

name: Magmortar
entry: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

name: Heatmor
entry: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Durant
entry: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

name: Munchlax
entry: It conceals food under the long fur on its body. It carts around this food stash and swallows it without chewing.

name: Snorlax
entry: What sounds like its cry may actually be its snores or the rumblings of its hungry belly.

name: Lapras
entry: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

name: Absol
entry: It has the ability to foretell natural disasters. Its life span is over a hundred years.

name: Rufflet
entry: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Braviary
entry: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Vullaby
entry: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

name: Mandibuzz
entry: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

name: Yamask
entry: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

name: Cofagrigus
entry: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

name: Minccino
entry: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

name: Cinccino
entry: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

name: Zorua
entry: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Zoroark
entry: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Omanyte
entry: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

name: Omastar
entry: Apparently, it cracked SHELLDER’s shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.

name: Kabuto
entry: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.

name: Kabutops
entry: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.

name: Aerodactyl
entry: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.

name: Anorith
entry: An ancestral Pokémon that lived in the ocean. Over time, its eight feet transformed into wings.

name: Armaldo
entry: Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through most anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.

name: Lileep
entry: It disguises its tentacles as flowers to attract and catch prey. It became extinct in ancient times.

name: Cradily
entry: It lives in warm seas. Its heavy body weighs it down so it won’t get washed away in rough weather.

name: Cranidos
entry: CRANIDOS toughen up their already rock-hard heads by headbutting one another.

name: Rampardos
entry: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.

name: Shieldon
entry: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.

name: Bastiodon
entry: When attacked, they form a wall. Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from the attacks.

name: Archen
entry: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

name: Archeops
entry: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.

name: Tirtouga
entry: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

name: Carracosta
entry: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

name: Amaura
entry: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

name: Aurorus
entry: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

name: Tyrunt
entry: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

name: Tyrantrum
entry: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

name: Pikipek
entry: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Trumbeak
entry: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

name: Toucannon
entry: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Grubbin
entry: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Charjabug
entry: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

name: Vikavolt
entry: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

name: Cutiefly
entry: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Ribombee
entry: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

name: Rockruff
entry: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

name: Lycanroc
entry: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

name: Yungoos
entry: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

name: Gumshoos
entry: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Stufful
entry: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
entry: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Bounsweet
entry: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

name: Steenee
entry: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

name: Tsareena
entry: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

name: Togedemaru
entry: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Dewpider
entry: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

name: Araquanid
entry: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

name: Pyukumuku
entry: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

name: Larvesta
entry: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

name: Volcarona
entry: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

name: Mesprit
entry: This Pokémon is said to have endowed the human heart with emotions, such as sorrow and joy.

name: Uxie
entry: According to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.

name: Azelf
entry: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life’s difficulties.

name: Lugia
entry: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

name: Ho-Oh
entry: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world’s skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.
